subject: repair
variant_mechanics: When you report a repair problem, Semptify creates a dated record of what you reported, when you reported it, and who you told. This helps you prove later that the landlord knew about the problem.
variant_trust: A written record protects you. If the landlord later claims they never knew about the leak, your dated entry shows otherwise.
variant_reinforcement: Write it down the same day it happens. A short note with the date is enough.

subject: repair
variant_mechanics: You can request repairs in writing and keep a copy. If the landlord does not fix the problem, you may be able to use your dated request as evidence to ask a court or housing inspector to step in.
variant_trust: A written repair request is one of the safest ways to protect yourself. It shows you followed the right steps and gave the landlord a fair chance to fix the problem.
variant_reinforcement: Send the request, keep a copy, and note the date. This is your proof.

subject: eviction
variant_mechanics: Eviction cases have strict deadlines. Missing a deadline can mean losing your case before you get a chance to tell your side. Semptify can help you track dates, but if you have a court filing or hearing coming up, you should also speak with a tenant advocate or legal aid office as soon as possible.
variant_trust: Eviction is the kind of problem where one missed date can change everything. Getting help from a legal advocate is free in most places and gives you a person who knows the local rules.
variant_reinforcement: Do not wait to get help if you have a court date or a deadline. A free advocate can double-check your dates.
